_readme: The Element Catalog — one staging-element family spanning both systems. Each element answers 'how does this artifact meet the world?' and has up to two forms: a floor-form (dressing-room POSTURE, a footing recipe of height tiles — tools/classify_postures.py) and a wall-form (a STATION prop — commons/artifacts/station/). Explicit nulls are first-class: they mark where an element genuinely lives on one side only (pit has no prop; lighting has no footing). Consumers: DressingRoomBuilder.gd (staged rendering), classify_postures.py, /staging page (future). 'station' lists CANDIDATES in preference order — a map, not a straitjacket. cfg templates use the props' real apply_grid_config keys; {rows}/{cols}/{height_m} substitute from the footing recipe.

pedestal.pick: station_micropod if artifact base_m < 1.0; station_plinth_wide if base_m > 1.6; else station_plinth

table.note: one posture fans to three surface props; bench is the default worktop

platform.note: station_gantry stages the same bay from above (opposite axis); not auto-placed

wall.note: the posture's 2.0m back face + 1.0m mount offset is exactly what wall+panel need; full curated clusters remain the Wall Hangar Editor's job

floor.note: the artifact IS the floor (mosaic/terrain) — no prop should be auto-placed under it. station_floorline is the wayfinding analog (joins bays) but stages a relation, not an object

float.note: HONEST GAP — no suspension prop exists (a gantry-hoist / ceiling mount would fill it); the posture lifts by bare artifact_offset.y

pit.note: grid has no negative heights, so the well is a raised rim; no prop can recess a floor either. station_barrier/handrail can dress the edge (not auto-placed)

shelf.note: 'the many' has no footing; an open shelf-rack is missing on BOTH sides

lighting.note: acts ON props rather than being an object-on-a-base; the dressing-room 'el' extra is its raw echo

circulation.note: postures raise platforms but never the way UP onto them

clutter.note: back-of-house believability; postures stage only the hero artifact

backdrop.note: deliberately grows no grid (footprint_cells 0, auto_ground false)

composer.note: 'many postures at once, rendered as real props' — the whole-bay meta-stager
